integrity: The graph and all 264 nonempty faces are reconstructed from an explicit edge list. The complete 120-pair discrete-Morse certificate is replayed against all 780 Hasse covers and independently cross-checked by mod-2 homology.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the icosahedral graph and does not classify arbitrary 5-regular graphs. The exact finite calculation was not found in the inspected sources or searches, but an obscure or unindexed prior computation under box-complex or Hom-complex terminology remains possible.
title: The icosahedral neighborhood complex is a wedge of twenty-three 2-spheres
